Mobilis signe un contrat de sponsoring a: Mobilis signs a sponsorship contract with MMA world champion Mohamed Saeed
Dans le cadre de ses efforts permanents: As part of its ongoing efforts to support Algerian elite and high-level sports and athletes, Mobilis signed, yesterday Sunday, June 14, 2026, a sponsorship contract with the Algerian fighter and "light heavyweight" world champion within the BRAVE CF organization, Mohamed Saeed Maallem, a specialist in mixed martial arts (MMA), who has brought honor to Algeria and the national colors.
Pour ce faire, le lutteur algérien Moham: To this end, the Algerian fighter Mohamed Saeed is now a mentor to the Mobilis family and enriches the list of brand ambassadors. This partnership aims to guarantee him the financial and moral support worthy of a world champion's status, and to continue writing his name in golden letters in various international arenas.
Mobilis, marque des champions et premier: Mobilis, the brand of champions and the leading sports partner in Algeria, thus renews its commitment to supporting the sporting elite and honoring the national flag.
